_about: Every room used by the schedule. lat/lng are WGS84; x/y are metres east/north of the West Temple & 200 South intersection (see wayfinding.json origin). Positions were placed from the official venue floor plans and OpenStreetMap building outlines, accurate to about ±15 m. level is the floor number shown in the venue (Level 1 = street level at 200 South). OFF has no position (off-site; use the official listing). PARTY-* rooms are off-site party venues without a position (scripts/fetch_parties.py).

151.name: Room 151
151.whereText: North of the North Foyer, past Rooms 150 A–F. Room 250/251 are directly above.
151.finalStep: Keep walking north past Rooms 150 A–F. Room 151 is the next room.

254.whereText: From the north end of the Upper Concourse, follow the corridor that curves north-west toward the Upper Mezzanine; 254 is on the bend.
254.finalStep: Room 254 is right on the bend of the corridor.

DE.name: Hall DE
DE.whereText: Hall DE opens off the west side of the Lower Concourse, the first hall north of the 200 South entrance.
DE.finalStep: Hall DE’s doors are on the west side of the concourse. This is the keynote hall.

SHOW.name: Showcase halls
SHOW.whereText: Solutions Showcase main entrance is on the west side of the Lower Concourse, opposite the Grand Ballroom. Halls A–C continue west into Halls 1–5.
SHOW.finalStep: The Solutions Showcase main entrance is on the west side of the concourse, opposite the Grand Ballroom.

ACE.name: Grand Ballroom ACE
ACE.whereText: Grand Ballroom, north half of the West Temple (east) row, toward the North Foyer.
ACE.finalStep: Grand Ballroom ACE is behind BDF on the West Temple side. Use the north ballroom doors, or enter from the North Foyer.

BDF.name: Grand Ballroom BDF
BDF.whereText: Grand Ballroom, north half of the row facing the Lower Concourse, toward the North Foyer.
BDF.finalStep: Grand Ballroom BDF is on the east side, at the north end of the ballroom.

H.name: Grand Ballroom H
H.whereText: Grand Ballroom, east side of the Lower Concourse, just north of J (near the Hyatt end).
H.finalStep: Grand Ballroom H is on the east side, right after Ballroom J.

GI.name: Grand Ballroom GI
GI.whereText: Grand Ballroom, south end of the West Temple (east) row. Enter from the Lower Concourse and go through the ballroom foyer.
GI.finalStep: Go through the east-side ballroom doors. GI is the south section along the West Temple side.

J.name: Grand Ballroom J
J.whereText: Grand Ballroom, east side of the Lower Concourse. J is the southern end, right next to the Hyatt connector.
J.finalStep: Grand Ballroom J is on the east side, the first ballroom doors after the Hyatt connector.

NGF.name: North Grand Ballroom Foyer
NGF.whereText: North Foyer, just north of the Grand Ballroom where the Lower Concourse meets the escalators.
NGF.finalStep: You’re there: this is the North Grand Ballroom Foyer.

250AC.name: 250 A–C
250AC.whereText: Upper Concourse, directly above Room 150. Take the North Foyer escalators up; 250 A–C is the south half of Room 250.
250AC.finalStep: Room 250 is the first room on the concourse. A–C is its south half, the end nearest the escalator.

250DF.name: 250 D–F
250DF.whereText: Upper Concourse, directly above Room 150. Take the North Foyer escalators up; 250 D–F is the north half of Room 250.
250DF.finalStep: Room 250 is the first room on the concourse. D–F is its north half.

251AC.name: 251 A–C
251AC.whereText: Upper Concourse, just north of Room 250 (above Room 151). 251 A–C is the south half.
251AC.finalStep: Walk past Room 250. 251 A–C is the south half of the next room.

251DF.name: 251 D–F
251DF.whereText: Upper Concourse, just north of Room 250 (above Room 151). 251 D–F is the north half.
251DF.finalStep: Walk past Room 250. 251 D–F is the north half of the next room.

253A.name: 253 A
253A.whereText: North end of the Upper Concourse past Room 251, next to the Speaker Lounge (253).
253A.finalStep: Room 253 A is here at the north end, next to the Speaker Lounge.

253B.name: 253 B
253B.whereText: North end of the Upper Concourse past Room 251, next to the Speaker Lounge (253).
253B.finalStep: Room 253 B is here at the north end, next to the Speaker Lounge.

255A.name: 255 A
255A.whereText: North-west wing, above Rooms 155. Upper Concourse → corridor past 254 → Upper Mezzanine. 255 A is the south-east room.
255A.finalStep: Rooms 255 are at the east end of the Upper Mezzanine. 255 A is the south-east room.

255D.name: 255 D
255D.whereText: North-west wing, above Rooms 155. Upper Concourse → corridor past 254 → Upper Mezzanine. 255 D is the south-west room.
255D.finalStep: Rooms 255 are at the east end of the Upper Mezzanine. 255 D is the south-west room.

255BC.name: 255 BC
255BC.whereText: North-west wing, above Rooms 155. Upper Concourse → corridor past 254 → Upper Mezzanine. 255 BC is on the east side, north of 255 A.
255BC.finalStep: Rooms 255 are at the east end of the Upper Mezzanine. 255 BC is on the east side, north of 255 A.

255EF.name: 255 EF
255EF.whereText: North-west wing, above Rooms 155. Upper Concourse → corridor past 254 → Upper Mezzanine. 255 EF is the north-west room.
255EF.finalStep: Rooms 255 are at the east end of the Upper Mezzanine. 255 EF is the north-west room.

UC.name: Upper Concourse
UC.whereText: Upper Concourse, at the top of the North Foyer escalators (also reached from the West Temple entrance at 100 South).
UC.finalStep: You’re there: this is the Upper Concourse.

UM.name: Upper Mezzanine
UM.whereText: Upper Mezzanine, running along the north side of Halls 1–5 at Level 2, beside Rooms 255.
UM.finalStep: You’re there: this is the Upper Mezzanine.

PP.name: Project Pavilion, Hall 5
PP.whereText: Project Pavilion in Hall 5 (Cosmic Canyon), the far west end of the showcase toward 300 West. Walk through Halls A–C, then west through Halls 1–4.
PP.finalStep: The Project Pavilion is in the Cosmic Canyon area of Hall 5.

CC.name: Cosmic Canyon stage, Hall 5
CC.whereText: Cosmic Canyon stage in Hall 5, the far west end of the showcase toward 300 West. Walk through Halls A–C, then west through Halls 1–4.
CC.finalStep: The Cosmic Canyon stage is in Hall 5.

DT.name: Demo Theater, Hall 1
DT.whereText: Demo Theater in Hall 1 (Alpine Overlook), where Halls A–C turn west into Halls 1–5, by the Secondary Entrance.
DT.finalStep: The Demo Theater is in the Alpine Overlook area of Hall 1.

NN.name: Network Nook, Hall 1
NN.whereText: Network Nook in Hall 1 (Alpine Overlook), where Halls A–C turn west into Halls 1–5, by the Secondary Entrance.
NN.finalStep: The Network Nook is in the Alpine Overlook area of Hall 1.

SSZ.name: Starlight Summit stage, Hall B
SSZ.whereText: Starlight Summit stage in Hall B, inside Halls A–C toward the Hall DE side. Enter at the Showcase main entrance.
SSZ.finalStep: The Starlight Summit stage is in Hall B, toward the Hall DE (south) side.

SLC.name: Salt Lake Ballroom C
SLC.whereText: Hyatt Level 2, middle section of the Salt Lake Ballroom (west side). Take the Hyatt escalators or elevators from the lobby; the foyer runs along the east side.
SLC.finalStep: Salt Lake Ballroom C is the middle section of the ballroom, off the west side of the foyer.

SLDE.name: Salt Lake Ballroom DE
SLDE.whereText: Hyatt Level 2, north end of the Salt Lake Ballroom (west side). Take the Hyatt escalators or elevators from the lobby.
SLDE.finalStep: Salt Lake Ballroom DE is the north end of the ballroom, off the west side of the foyer.

SLF.name: Salt Lake Foyer South
SLF.whereText: Hyatt Level 2, Salt Lake Foyer South at the south end of the ballroom level. Take the Hyatt escalators or elevators from the lobby.
SLF.finalStep: Salt Lake Foyer South is at the south end of the Level 2 foyer.

PC.name: Park City
PC.whereText: Hyatt Level 3, the rounded room at the south end beside the elevator lobby.
PC.finalStep: Park City is the rounded room at the south end, next to the elevator lobby.

RA.name: Regency Ballroom A
RA.whereText: Hyatt Level 4, Regency Ballroom A is the south end of the ballroom (west side). Escalators arrive in the Regency Foyer on the east side.
RA.finalStep: Regency Ballroom A is the south end of the ballroom: on your left as you face the ballroom doors.

RB.name: Regency Ballroom B
RB.whereText: Hyatt Level 4, Regency Ballroom B is the middle section (west side). Escalators arrive in the Regency Foyer on the east side.
RB.finalStep: Regency Ballroom B is the middle section, straight ahead as you face the ballroom doors.

RBD.name: Regency Ballroom B–D
RBD.whereText: Hyatt Level 4, Regency Ballroom B–D is the middle and north sections combined (west side). Escalators arrive in the Regency Foyer.
RBD.finalStep: Regency Ballroom B–D is the middle and north sections: straight ahead and to your right as you face the ballroom doors.

RCD.name: Regency Ballroom CD
RCD.whereText: Hyatt Level 4, Regency Ballroom CD is the north end (west side). Escalators arrive in the Regency Foyer on the east side.
RCD.finalStep: Regency Ballroom CD is the north end of the ballroom: on your right as you face the ballroom doors.

CR.name: Capitol Reef
CR.whereText: Hyatt Level 5, Capitol Reef toward the north end of the meeting corridor. Take the Hyatt elevators.
CR.finalStep: Capitol Reef is toward the north end of the Level 5 corridor.

HL.name: Hyatt lobby
HL.whereText: Hyatt Regency lobby. From the Salt Palace, go to the south end of the Lower Concourse (badge pick-up) and through the Hyatt connector.
HL.finalStep: You’re there: this is the Hyatt lobby.

REG.name: Registration and badge pick-up
REG.whereText: Main entrance on 200 South, at the south end of the Lower Concourse beside the Hyatt connector.
REG.finalStep: Badge pick-up is just inside the 200 South entrance.

COAT.name: Coat and bag check
COAT.whereText: East Registration on the Upper Concourse, inside the West Temple entrance at 100 South.
COAT.finalStep: Coat and bag check is at East Registration, just inside the West Temple entrance.

PARTY-ADDRESS-ON-REGISTRATION.name: Address on registration
PARTY-ADDRESS-ON-REGISTRATION.whereText: Off-site. The host shares the address when you register.

PARTY-FLANKER-KITCHEN.name: Flanker Kitchen
PARTY-FLANKER-KITCHEN.whereText: Off-site, at 6 N Rio Grande St.

PARTY-MUSEUM-OF-ILLUSIONS.name: Museum of Illusions
PARTY-MUSEUM-OF-ILLUSIONS.whereText: Off-site, at 110 S Rio Grande St.

PARTY-PUBLIK-SPACE.name: Publik Space
PARTY-PUBLIK-SPACE.whereText: Off-site, at 975 S W Temple St.
